semiconductor_relevance: High — Ohara Optical specializes in high-precision optical materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in photolithography and metrology.
summary: Ohara Optical (M) Sdn Bhd provides advanced optical materials, including ultra-low expansion glass-ceramics and high-homogeneity optical glass, tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products support critical applications in photolithography, wafer handling, and metrology systems, enhancing performance and precision in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: CLEARCERAMTM Series: Ultra-low expansion glass-ceramic for positioning stages and lithography reference beams
High-Homogeneity i-Line Optical Glass for steppers and projection lenses
VAD-Process Synthetic Fused Silica for photomasks

regional_presence.APAC: Ohara supports the semiconductor ecosystem across APAC and South Asia with its material innovations.
